title: Paper-Claim Denials for a Required Review: Units on Quantity Limit Renewals
content:
Cash purchases show need beyond the limit, and on a quantity limit renewal approved under the Utilization Management Program they add units to the renewal approval ceiling.

**Rule.** 2 or more paper claims for the drug denied because a coverage review was required, with the denial dated within the last 6 months, add 2 units; exactly 1 such denial adds 1 unit; none adds nothing.

The paper claims are those submitted under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit for the same drug, and only denials for the reason that a coverage review was required count. The 6 months end on the decision date: a denial counts when dated after the same day of the month six months before the decision date.

| Qualifying denials within 6 months | Units |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

*Hypothetical case:* decision date 30 September; qualifying denials on 2 April and 31 March. Six months before is 30 March, so both count and 2 units are added. A third denial on 29 March would not count, but the units would stay at 2.
